lighthouseBaseline.chromeVersionPolicy: Record the exact runtime version and warn when its major version differs from 150.
lighthouseBaseline.cacheState: cold; Lighthouse storage reset enabled before every run
lighthouseBaseline.aggregation: median per category, audit score, and numeric metric
lighthouseBaseline.notes: Simulated throttling improves run-to-run comparability but does not make performance measurements deterministic. Compare only runs with matching configuration and compatible runtime versions.
